### id=106822473 | IRCTC | exchange category: Change in Management
subject: Indian Railway Catering And Tourism Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management
excerpt: Sub: Intimation regarding Change in Senior Management – Cessation 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
In compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, it is to inform that Sh. Suresh Kumar Sharma, 
presently working on deputation as Group General Manager/Services/IRCTC/CO (One 
Level Below Board – Senior Management Personnel), has been repatriated on 
19.10.2026 (AN) prematurely on his own request. Accordingly, subsequent to his 
relieving from IRCTC, he ceases to be Senior Management Personnel with effect from 
today, i.e. 19.10.2026 (AN). 
This is for your kind information and record please. 
Thanking you, 
Yours faithfully, 
For and on behalf of Indian Railway Catering & 
Tourism Corporation Limited 
(Suman Kalra) 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer
